structured_output.summary: Removed the duplicated −1…+1 steer clamp. `clampSteer` in src/input/gamepad.ts is now exported, and src/input/index.ts imports it and uses it in read() (`const steer = clampSteer((right ? 1 : 0) - (left ? 1 : 0) + p.steer);`) in place of its own inline `Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, …))`. Both versions compute the same thing, so behaviour doesn't change. This is a duplication fix, so there is no red/green test; the existing gamepad, keyboard and touch input tests cover it. pnpm typecheck passes and pnpm test passes (82 files, 623 tests).
